items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: We're going to take Freddie Kepert's place, Mabel, Elaine and the New Orleans Jazz Band.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . and this band comes to me and wants a band to go to Chicago and we're going to travel. We're going to take Freddie Kepert's place, Mabel, Elaine and the New Orleans Jazz Band.

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: And he's sick now, and Freddie played, you see?

ctx.x: Did you play with him in Chicago?
Oh, yeah. When he come to Chicago -- when he come back from New York to come back to Chicago, he was playing with this girl that I went to play with, May Elaine.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Joe Freddie Keppard Manny Perez Bunk alright that was four really hot trumpet players

ctx.x: who do you think was a better trumpet player Keppard or Oliver oh

Joe Joe well yeah as I say you take Joe Freddie Keppard Manny Perez Bunk alright that was four really hot trumpet players see but every one of them played alright but they all played a different style so therefore you can't say nothing everybody in Chicago want to know who was the best of the players so they went to work and they got Joe was playing at the Royal Garden they went and got Manny Perez they got Joe and they got Freddie and they put them all over there to play one night?
